category_title: Latino/a students with externalizing behaviors who retaliate physically to racial microaggressions
scenario_title: Academic difficulties, goofing off, and late homework
minimal_context: The student is participating in independent work time in the classroom and is asked to turn in a homework assignment.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for independent work. Please take out your homework assignment from yesterday so I can collect it.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't have it done. I need a couple of more days to do it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: The deadline for the homework is today.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Why are you being so hard on me? I'm trying to tell you why my homework is late.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to complete your assignments on time.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: You're not understanding at all. I'm not doing this right now. (Pushes the assignment away and starts goofing off)
